title: MV Yanfly CTB with SV Actors change animation defaults?

posts.author: FrozenFacade
posts.body: When using Yanfly's Charge Turn Battle system with SV Actors it seems like every action defaults to the "Ready/Physical" animation. Is there a way to make magical skills have the "Ready/Magical" animation by default? (I am using Yanfly's action sequence plugins but I would hope there is a way to change the CTB defaults)

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: I tested it (Core Engine, Battle Core, CTB ) and it seemed to do chant motions. I assume you meant the motions. It did the correct skill/magic animations too.

posts.author: FrozenFacade
posts.body:
Yeah, I turned off CTB and I still seem to be getting the physical animations showing first I'll mess around and try to figure out what's causing it. (And yes I did mean the chant motion not showing)
OK NVM...  I basically made my entire game and because I was leaving custom sprites for the very end I went the whole time not realizing you had to drop new skill types into the "Magic Skills" section of the Database System tab for them to default to magic animations xD.
It seems silly to be learning about something so simple 3000+ hours in but I never really looked into motion stuff until now LOL.
